pull.title: depends: fix non-atomic reads in capnp debug assertions
pull.body:
KJ's debug assertions read the mutex futex word and `AtomicRefcounted` refcounts non-atomically. The TSan job builds capnp without optimization, which automatically enables these assertions, and TSan reports these reads as data races the moment KJ objects start communicating across threads.

libmultiprocess enables cross-thread communication for the first time in bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess#376, which replaces the pipe used in `EventLoop::sync()` with `kj::Executor::executeSync()`. This is what triggered the [failure](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess/actions/runs/38094008438/job/114336046070?pr=376).

Patches are the upstream commits capnproto/capnproto@b91a6ba7c7 and capnproto/capnproto@cc13c8c45f, which are backports of the v2 fixes in capnproto/capnproto#2781 and capnproto/capnproto#2843 (backport PR: capnproto/capnproto#2855).

ACK 6e8e85ddcf2eb4a062fab3cd2b9c046edfbf72ec

I verified that the patches match upstream, and that TSan needs both (if we continue with https://github.com/bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess/pull/376).

If we want capnp's tests to pass under TSan, we'd have to backport several other changes. But given that we set `BUILD_TESTING=OFF`, I guess it's unnecessary to backport things just to make tests pass? (I did manage locally)

Thanks @Sjors! I'm not sure which exact tests would fail and need backports, but I'd lean toward keeping `BUILD_TESTING=OFF` as you said, so we don't unnecessarily backport things just to make them work.

Code review ACK 6e8e85ddcf2eb4a062fab3cd2b9c046edfbf72ec. Thanks for tracking down the race and getting the fix merged upstream first, which makes the patches easy to check.

I checked that both patch files are identical to `git format-patch` output for capnproto/capnproto@b91a6ba7c7 and capnproto/capnproto@cc13c8c45f apart from the git version in the signature line, that these are the two commits capnproto/capnproto#2855 merged

comments.body:
re: Sjors https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36556#issuecomment-6311264354

In commit "depends: fix non-atomic reads in capnp debug assertions" (6e8e85ddcf2eb4a062fab3cd2b9c046edfbf72ec)

> given that we set `BUILD_TESTING=OFF`, I guess it's unnecessary to backport things just to make tests pass?

Yeah, backporting test-only fixes could add more patches to maintain, so I think current approach is reasonable, though theoretically enabling more test could expose issues worth fixing.

In commit "depends: fix non-atomic reads in capnp debug assertions" (6e8e85ddcf2eb4a062fab3cd2b9c046edfbf72ec)

Note: these two patches can be dropped when depends moves to a capnp release that includes capnproto/capnproto#2855, which was merged into capnproto master after v1.5.0.
